lines.text: Zedekiah becomes king at twenty-one, does evil like Jehoiakim, and rebels against the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, and Zedekiah is overtaken in the plains of Jericho, where his whole army deserts him.
At Damascus, the king of Babylon slaughters Zedekiah's sons, puts out his eyes, and takes him to Babylon.
Nebuzaradan burns the house of the LORD, and the Chaldeans carry the bronze pillars and the Sea to Babylon.
Evil-merodach sends Jehoiachin back home to Judah, and he dines at the king's table for the rest of his life.

wrong_details.wrong: sends him back home to Judah
wrong_details.true: pardons him and releases him from prison, keeping him in Babylon
